raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (322 rows, ingested 2026-01-18) delivers txn_ts in DD/MM/YYYY form (e.g. '17/01/2026 06:10:32'), which the ISO-only CAST rejects. Day-first is the only valid reading because 17 cannot be a month, and the txn date sits one day before the ingest date, as in other batches, so parsing slash-format values as %d/%m/%Y repairs silver and gold without changing their schema.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN txn_ts LIKE '__/__/____ __:__:__' THEN strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S') ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN txn_ts LIKE '__/__/____ __:__:__' THEN strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S') ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
